drafts.rationale: EV-O-A09 defines a distinct locus: one original execution may be followed by at most three retries, after which the job must not be executed again.
drafts.subject: Orion job execution

drafts.rationale: EV-O-B09 specifies the wait required before each retry and that the wait must not vary with attempt number.
drafts.subject: Orion job retry

drafts.rationale: EV-O-C09 bounds how long an individual execution may run and requires a stop at that limit to be recorded as a failed attempt.
drafts.subject: Orion job execution

drafts.rationale: EV-O-D09 requires further deliveries of an already-active job id to be ignored without changing the active job's state.
drafts.subject: Orion job delivery

drafts.rationale: EV-O-E09 requires each idempotency key to be retained for twenty-four hours after first seen, after which a later same-key delivery is treated as new.
drafts.subject: Orion idempotency key

drafts.rationale: EV-O-F09 sets how long a worker lease lasts from delivery and that expiry without renewal or release makes the job available to other workers.
drafts.subject: Orion worker lease

drafts.rationale: EV-O-G09 allows renewal every thirty seconds while work progresses and requires each renewal to extend the lease by the full lease duration.
drafts.subject: Orion worker lease

drafts.rationale: EV-O-H09 states that cancellation bars future attempts, does not interrupt a running attempt, and that a repeated cancellation leaves an already-cancelled job unchanged.
drafts.subject: Orion job

drafts.rationale: EV-O-I09 requires an automatic move to the dead-letter queue after the last unsuccessful attempt and forbids further execution unless the job is explicitly resubmitted.
drafts.subject: Orion job

drafts.rationale: EV-O-J09 requires an operator escalation when three dead-letter events for the same tenant occur within one hour measured from the first event.
drafts.subject: Orion tenant dead-letter events

drafts.rationale: EV-O-K09 guarantees first-in-first-out execution only among jobs in the same partition and makes no ordering promise across partitions.
drafts.subject: Orion queue partition

drafts.rationale: EV-O-L09 requires audit events to be retained for thirty days after recording and allows deletion thereafter.
drafts.subject: Orion audit event

drafts.rationale: EV-O-A01 requires that a job be executed at most three times in total and that the first execution counts as one of those three.
EV-O-A09 caps retries at three after the original execution and forbids any further execution after the third unsuccessful retry.

value.text: One original execution may be followed by no more than three retry executions; once three retries have ended without success the job must not be executed again.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-B09 requires a wait of exactly five seconds before every retry, measured from the end of the failed attempt and not varied by attempt number.
EV-O-B05 requires a two-second wait before the first retry, doubling before each later retry, with a thirty-second cap.

value.text: Wait two seconds before the first retry, then double the previous wait before each later retry, never exceeding thirty seconds.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-C09 limits an individual execution to half a minute and requires that reaching the limit stop the execution and record a failed attempt.
EV-O-C09 states that an execution stopped at the half-minute limit must be recorded as a failed attempt.

value.text: An execution stopped at the time limit must be recorded as a failed attempt.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-D09 requires ignoring duplicate deliveries of an active job id without changing that job's state.

value.text: While a job with a given job id is active, further deliveries carrying the same job id must be ignored and must not change the active job's state.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-E09 requires each idempotency key to be retained for twenty-four hours after it is first seen.
EV-O-E09 allows a key to be forgotten after retention and treats a later delivery with that key as new.

value.text: After the retention period the key may be forgotten and a later delivery with the same key is treated as new.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-F01 requires a worker lease to last sixty seconds from delivery to the worker.
EV-O-F09 requires a worker lease to last ninety seconds from delivery to the worker.
EV-O-F09 states that an unre-newed, unreleased lease expiry makes the job available to other workers.

value.text: When the lease expires without renewal or release, the job must become available to other workers.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-G09 allows a worker to renew its lease every thirty seconds while work on the job is progressing.
EV-O-G09 requires each renewal to extend the lease by the full lease duration from the renewal moment.

value.text: A renewal must extend the lease by the full lease duration from the moment of renewal.

drafts.predicate: effect on future and in-flight attempts
drafts.rationale: EV-O-H09 forbids starting further attempts after cancellation and requires an in-flight attempt to run to its own end.

value.text: After a job is cancelled, no future execution attempt may be started; cancellation must not interrupt an already running attempt, which runs to completion, failure, or timeout.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-H09 requires a repeated cancellation to keep the job cancelled without otherwise changing its state.

value.text: A cancellation for a job that is already cancelled must leave the job cancelled and must not otherwise change the job's state.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-I09 requires an automatic move to the dead-letter queue after the final unsuccessful attempt.

value.text: After the final unsuccessful execution attempt, Orion must automatically move the job to the dead-letter queue.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-I09 forbids executing a dead-lettered job again unless it is explicitly resubmitted.

value.text: A job in the dead-letter queue must not be executed again unless explicitly resubmitted.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-J09 requires an operator escalation at three same-tenant dead-letter events within one hour of the first event.

value.text: When three dead-letter events occur for the same tenant within one hour, measured from the first of the three events, Orion must raise an operator escalation.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-K09 limits the FIFO guarantee to jobs in the same partition and denies any ordering between partitions.

value.text: FIFO execution order is guaranteed only among jobs in the same queue partition; no ordering guarantee is made between jobs in different partitions.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-L09 requires audit events to be retained for thirty days after they are recorded and allows deletion after that period.
